evidence: The converter (workload/trace_to_two_pool.py) consumes the trace's raw arrival TIMESTAMP (L4-8) and models only two accelerator-side stages: a FIFO encoder pool (queue+service+handoff, L485-493) and the LLM pool via dynamo.replay. ContextTokens already includes text+image tokens so 'no vision-token arithmetic is added here' (L27-28) — i.e. no tokenization stage is simulated. No image fetch/decode/preprocessing/front-end-queueing stage exists anywhere in the pipeline; the modeled boundary is accelerator service + queueing, matching twopool.tex:406-408.
